binaryPatches.justification: Owl OSCrypt names its Keychain service from a hard-coded "Codex" built from instruction immediates (builder/KEYCHAIN.md); the trailing 'x' (movz w8,#0x78) becomes 'y', so the copy uses "Codey Storage Key" and never the stock app's item
same for the Keychain account: "Codey" (item "Codey Storage Key")

R2-6: when the copy's own item is missing OSCrypt falls back to another OpenAI app's "Aura Safe Storage" item; the last character immediate becomes 'f' ("Aura Safe Storagf"), so the fallback can never read it
R2-6: the fallback account "Aura" becomes "Aurb" (high byte of the second halfword immediate)
